# CANDIDATE: VIX_PULLBACK_RIBBON_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Elevated VIX often creates overbought short-term spikes; a pullback to VWAP with bullish ribbon alignment offers a mean-reversion long edge. We aim to capture this by entering longs when VIX is elevated (>20), RSI is oversold (<30), price is near VWAP (within 0.1%), and the EMA ribbon is bullish (EMA9>EMA20>EMA50).

## Mechanism

Entry: On 5-minute bars, when all of the following are true at the bar close:
- VIX(close) > 20
- RSI(14) < 30
- |Close - VWAP| / Close < 0.001 (within 0.1%)
- EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50 (bullish ribbon alignment)
Enter long at the close of the bar that meets all three conditions.

Exit: 
- Initial stop: low of the entry bar (chart-stop)
- Target: 1.5R (risk-reward) from entry to stop
- After hitting target, trail the remaining position with a Chandelier exit (ATR(14) x 2.5)
- Additionally, restrict trading to 10:30-14:00 ET and avoid first/last 30 minutes; only take trades when VIX is between 20 and 35 (to avoid extreme volatility).
